method_notes: A composite is trusted when at least 30% of its pixels are rated 'good' by MODIS QA, or it is nearly cloud-free; others are drawn faintly and never flagged.
Seasonal median = median NDVI of the same and neighbouring 16-day periods in all other years (leave-one-year-out); σ = 1.4826 × MAD with a floor of 0.03; normal range = median ± 2σ.
Seasonal flag: |z| ≥ 2 and NDVI at least 0.05 away from the median. Threshold flag: NDVI fell by ≥ 0.1 since the previous trusted composite.
Event rainfall = total over each composite window plus the preceding 32 days, compared with the same windows in other years.
Explanations rank which drivers the available data are consistent with. They are evidence checks, not proof of cause.
